recentItems.title: Watch: Sasa Africa | Beyond Stereotypes: What you don't know about Africa
recentItems.description:
Africa is famous for its vibrant cultures and traditions. Some well understood, others less so. The continent offers people and visitors alike a rich array of experiences spanning food, music, identity, everyday life and new realities.

In this second episode of #SasaAfrica, we bring together voices from across Africa and beyond to explore the continent beyond the stereotypes. Expect laughter, fresh perspectives, a few surprises and perhaps a few myths gently busted along the way.

Because Africa is many things to many people, and there's always more to the story. @CGTN Africa

recentItems.title: Xi Jinping's time in New Delhi: Opening BRICS' next 'Golden Decade'
recentItems.description:
Chinese President Xi Jinping has concluded his attendance at the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi on Sunday.

Speaking at the summit, Xi reviewed two decades of BRICS cooperation and outlined priorities for its next stage of development. China will assume the BRICS chairship in 2027, working with all members to advance the BRICS' next stage of cooperation.

recentItems.title: President Pezeshkian says Iran is 'not at war' with Saudi Arabia
recentItems.description:
Amid escalating regional tensions, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian emphasized that Iran is "not at war" with Saudi Arabia and has "no problems with the UAE" or other neighboring nations. 

However, he reaffirmed Tehran's firm opposition to the presence of US military bases in the Middle East.

Pezeshkian delivered these remarks during an interview in New Delhi, where he was attending the weekend BRICS summit.
